decisions.reason: The relaunch as 518 FLEX and positive reference to past popularity suggest performance at or above aspiration, so the product is likely satisfactory and retained.
Updating all AK models to EU Stage V indicates continued investment and satisfactory results, meeting aspirations for this product line.
Its move from a mention to its own page suggests growing visibility, but with less specific performance evidence its results are somewhat more uncertain, yet slack supports keeping it.
Strong launch language and quantified applications for the CERON generation imply above-aspiration performance, making withdrawal very unlikely.
